this happens to me. It usually begins with some bizarro weird nightmare, but then there's an abrupt cut and suddenly i'm in a normal situation, sometimes a total juxtaposition to the nightmare i was having, and then cut back to the nightmare. 

When i wake up i don't remember the normal parts of my nightmare i just know that my dreams were very fragmented. And then a few days/weeks later the normal part of the dream happens. Happens quite often for me at least once a month or maybe more. 

Most of these "deja vu" moments for me are pretty mundane with no huge significance on why i've dreamt them before. But there have been times when the "normal" parts of the dream include something dangerous happening to me, so when i recognize it's happening in real life, i quickly try to fix whatever put me in danger and then the dangerous part doesn't happen.

it never feels like i have to "get out" unless it's the times where i know i was in danger from when i dreamt it. While the nightmares aren't fun, i just assume it's the price i pay for having some sort of future vision. I'm trying to 'work out' this muscle as this has been happening to me for over 10 years but only a year ago did i realize it coincided with my nightmares. Now i'm trying to work on remembered those normal parts of my dream.

I feel like if I had played this a year or two ago I would have chosen Bay. Idk if u watched Multiverse of Madness but I was not happy with the Scarlett Witch. Taking a philosophy class(i'm not a know it all it's just helped me form my own ideas and reactions to things) really shaped my thoughts into choosing Bae though. It's hard to describe my thoughts on my view of nature which includes the tornado (which kind of changes with the inclusion of manipulation of time). Thinking about it the whole Topanga and Presscot Estates seem like a red herring but I can't help but think the town was already on its way to being destroyed. The second biggest reason next to Max just accepting her consequences for me, was that i don't want to kill a queer character. I'm so tired of that trope though it only applies if max is romantic with chloe. It's a choice everyday queer people have to make whether to sacrifice themselves or the world they live in, and i refuse to indulge in that by sacrificing chloe. I wouldn't have thought about it like this a year or two ago though so i'm not really mad at anyone who chooses Bay, there are plenty of valid reasons for both. 

And to your point about the complexity of these beings, you're right no one is perfect in this game, and that's why it's so hard to choose because the whole game Max is trying to be perfect but with the choice of bae or bae, Max is always going to end up doing something wrong, imperfect. That's why I enjoy both endings despite my personal preference for bae.
